about: Where each short-video platform's own screens cover a vertical frame, as fractions of it, measured on a 1080x1920 frame from the platforms' published templates and guides (sources: docs/specs/safe-zones.md). The app's template/SafeZone.kt and the web's lib/safezone.ts read these.

platforms.doc: TikTok: top 240 px, bottom 660 px, left 120 px, right 300 px (120 px margin plus its 180 px button column; the margin is 120 px above y=840).
Reels: 14% top, 35% bottom, 6% at the sides.
Shorts: top 288 px (15%), bottom 672 px (35%), left 48 px, right 192 px.
